name: Gossamer
author: E. T. Carter
description: Aurora curtains: several translucent sheets of light hang at different depths over a dark sky, each brightest along a soft folding lower hem and fading diffusely upward, combed into fine vertical striations that lean with the folds and bunch where a sheet turns edge-on. The far sheets sit higher and drift slower, the near one is tall and bright, and colour climbs the palette with height.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the sheets slide sideways and their folds evolve; 0 hangs them still.

params.label: Curtain gap
params.effect: How much of each sheet is missing along its length; 0 hangs an unbroken curtain, high leaves scattered fragments of light.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the curtains; low is a faint suggestion, high floods the sky.

params.label: Sky glow
params.effect: Horizon haze and the dim scatter in the sky between the sheets; 0 drops the background to plain black.

params.label: Sheets
params.effect: Number of curtain layers hanging at different depths; 1 is a single near sheet, 4 stacks far, dim sheets behind it.

params.label: Striation
params.effect: Fineness and contrast of the vertical rays inside each sheet; 0 smooths them into a plain glow, high combs them into dense needles.

params.label: Height
params.effect: How tall the sheets rise above their hems before fading out; low hugs the horizon, high reaches the top of the frame.
